items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: he could hear Walter Page cut through the band

ctx.x: I saw an interview with him and he said when he was 13 years old he went to hear Basie’s band and he could hear Walter Page, he would be up in the balcony and he could hear Walter Page cut through the band. You know? And you know that says a lot that the acoustic bass could be heard.
And there’s a percussiveness to it that I think serves well when you’re in a trio like, without a drummer. The bass becomes the percussion as well.
